limitations: This is the as-observed partial snapshot for the exact pushed commit and attempt, not a terminal conclusion for the three queued workflows.
Queued jobs remain queued; no timeout, host-unavailability, execution or qualification is inferred from waiting.
API status values and API timestamps are retained without treating a queued job started_at field as proof of execution.
Workflow step names describe intended commands; a failed named target step alone does not prove compiler, linker, simulator or target test execution.
The two successful Linux jobs establish their observed GitHub job status only; original test report artifacts, counts and package contents were not inspected by this collector.
Run head SHA identifies the workflow candidate; it is not complete same-job loaded broker/driver/provider/runtime artifact enrollment.
Failed checkout/build/prerequisite paths are not passed provider controls. Later fixes or later runs cannot retroactively change this commit observation.
Raw logs remain private; this record retains only exact log byte digests, sizes, bounded collection metadata and sanitized technical diagnoses.
CI harness process-group cleanup is best effort, not a sandbox or native production supervision/descendant-absence proof.
